name: Earth Shield
description: Protects the target with an earthen shield, reducing casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30%  and causing attacks to heal the shielded target for .  This effect can only occur once every few seconds.  6 charges.  Lasts 10 min.  Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time and only one Elemental Shield can be active on a target at a time.
buff_text: Reduces casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30% and attacks heal the shielded target for 150.
